summary: Practise GBVIMS classification, data-quality checks and safe information sharing. Explore the course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: GBV information management training helps staff responsible for case information and programme reporting handle reported incident data safely and consistently. Participants practise classifying records with the GBVIMS Classification Tool, checking completeness and consistency, and assessing information-sharing requests with attention to consent, confidentiality and disclosure risk. They also review aggregate trends and prepare privacy-conscious reports for programme decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle GBV case information or make decisions about its safe use in service delivery and programme reporting.
